Robert Guest

Deputy editor



 When I was a student I sold Christmas cards to raise money for UNICEF. To potential donors sipping ale in English pubs, I’d stress that for less than the price of a pint they could pay for a vaccine shot that might save the life of a child in Africa. Many reached for their wallets, but I remember one who said, in a rather peeved voice: “Why don’t you raise money for British children?”

What Is Bybit TradFi? Bybit TradFi is a dedicated section on the Bybit App and website designed to make traditional market access easier to find, understand, and trade. It brings two products together under one category: TradFi Perpetuals and CFD. Together, they give users access to selected traditional market exposure across forex, metals, indices, stocks, and commodities, while keeping the experience connected to the Bybit ecosystem. A Clearer Product Structure As part of the July 2026 update, the product previously known as “TradFi” has been renamed CFD. For existing users, the core trading experience remains unchanged. Instruments, leverage, fee structures, available funds, and open positions remain the same. The update mainly improves how TradFi products are organized, making it easier for users to understand which product fits their trading style. TradFi Perpetuals TradFi Perpetuals are designed for users who want traditional market exposure through a familiar Bybit-native experience. They trade 24/7, settle in USDT, and can be accessed through the Unified Trading Account. No MT5 download or separate account setup is required. This makes TradFi Perpetuals suitable for users who want simpler access to selected traditional markets using the same infrastructure they already use on Bybit. CFD CFD is designed for users who want broader instrument coverage and more advanced trading tools. It provides access to 400+ instruments and is available through MetaTrader 5, Bybit App, and Bybit Web. It also supports advanced charting, Expert Advisors, and leverage of up to 500x on selected forex pairs. CFD uses a dedicated MT5 CFD Account, separate from the Unified Trading Account. Choosing the Right Product TradFi Perpetuals are best suited for users who want 24/7 access, USDT settlement, and a simple Bybit-native experience. CFD is better suited for users who want MT5 tools, a wider range of instruments, and more advanced trading functionality. The Bottom Line Bybit TradFi gives users a clearer way to access selected traditional markets from one platform. TradFi Perpetuals offer simplicity and 24/7 access. CFD offers broader coverage and advanced tools. The result is a more organized bridge between digital asset trading and traditional market exposure.
